raw_segments.text: The Proverbs, being a collection of wise and godly sayings, partly of Solomon, partly of
Agar the son of J.K., and partly of the mother of King Lemuel, cannot probably be thought
to have been collected by Solomon, rather than by Agar or the mother of Lemus.
And that, though the sentences be theirs, yet the collection or compiling them into
this one book, was the work of some other godly man that lived after them all.
